beats.vo: This is Groundtruth, a Chrome extension that sits beside a realestate.com.au or Domain listing. Here's an apartment on Belvoir Street in Surry Hills.
beats.caption: [[Chrome extension]] · realestate.com.au + Domain

beats.vo: Up top, the price check. Microburbs values it at seven hundred and eighty-five thousand, but this agency's sales usually land above guide, so it's likely to go for about eight hundred and thirty.
beats.caption: Microburbs value $785k · likely [[~$830k]]

beats.vo: How do we know it's the right home? Groundtruth reads only the address and shows its receipt: the exact unit, matched on unit, number, street and suburb.
beats.caption: Address match receipt · [[unit · number · street · suburb]]

beats.vo: The agency card shows why. Seven of McGrath's last ten sales beat their guide, by about four percent.
beats.caption: McGrath: [[7 of 10]] sales beat guide · ~4%

beats.vo: Been quoted a different number? Type it in. Nine hundred thousand is above both the guide on record and Microburbs' estimate, so it's worth asking the agent why.
beats.caption: Type your guide · [[$900k]] vs record and estimate

beats.vo: Browse normally. Click into another listing and the panel follows: Goulburn Street, then Bourke Street, each matched fresh.
beats.caption: Panel follows you · [[each listing matched fresh]]

beats.vo: Scroll down for what listings rarely mention. This Bourke Street apartment has heritage on the property, sits thirty-five metres from a high-voltage line, and its street is forecast to grow a little slower than Surry Hills.
beats.caption: [[Heritage on property]] · HV line 35 m · street vs suburb

beats.vo: Strata levies in the suburb run about five thousand three hundred a year, worth budgeting for.
beats.caption: Strata levy ~[[$5,320/yr]] suburb median

beats.vo: And this is the 3D view. Your building in blue, glass where neighbours are allowed to build higher. Two lots nearby could add four to five storeys.
beats.caption: 3D: [[2 lots could rise 4–5 storeys]]

beats.vo: It works on Domain too. Same panel, same exact match.
beats.caption: [[Domain]] · same exact match

beats.vo: Now the feature buyers love: the thirty-second briefing. Tap play and Groundtruth talks you through the home.
beats.caption: ▶ 30-sec briefing · tap to listen

beats.vo: (Briefing audio, ElevenLabs Sarah, text = captions shown in the panel.)
beats.caption: Spoken briefing · captions in the panel

beats.vo: If a listing hides the unit number, Groundtruth won't guess. It asks how many bedrooms and narrows the building.
beats.caption: Hidden unit · tap [[bedrooms]] to narrow

beats.vo: Outside the City of Sydney, it tells you plainly and stays quiet.
beats.caption: Out of area · [[no data call]]

beats.vo: Groundtruth. Built on the Microburbs API, and ready to drop into any property extension.
beats.caption: Built on the [[Microburbs API]]
